title: Your money record, your story and your next 90 days

say: Your money record, your story and your next 90 days.
This is the video for module four of Managing Money in Daily Life.
Your final project is not a test of how much money you have. It is proof that you can see, understand and change your own daily money.
A 1,500 naira a week improvement that is true is worth far more than a perfect record that is not.

panel.heading: Proof that you can change your money

say: Part A is your two-week spending record, with daily and category totals. Part B is a one-page report on one spending pattern you changed.

panel.heading: Proof that you can change your money

say: Part C is your progress table with the five weekly measures. Part D is your 90-day plan.

panel.heading: Proof that you can change your money

say: Gather all your daily notes for the two weeks. Check every entry has a category. Put anything unclear in unknown rather than guessing.

panel.heading: Tidy your two-week record
items: Gather all your notes for 14 days
Category totals must equal daily totals

say: Check your digital spending against your bank and wallet statements for the same dates. Then total each day and each category, and make sure both add up to the same figure.

panel.heading: Tidy your two-week record
items: Gather all your notes for 14 days
Category totals must equal daily totals

say: Before you photograph or upload anything, hide your account numbers, card numbers, BVN and transaction references. Your categories and amounts are enough. Never upload a full bank statement.

panel.heading: Tidy your two-week record
items: Gather all your notes for 14 days
Category totals must equal daily totals
panel.rule: Hide account numbers, card numbers and BVN before sharing.

say: Use five short headings: the pattern, the evidence, the rule, the result, and what you learned.
Esther's pattern was extra keke and okada rides, because she bought baking ingredients on different days. Her record showed 9 of 22 rides were ingredient trips.

card.title: A pattern-change report
card.note: Saved over four weeks. Illustrative figures.

say: Her evidence: in weeks 1 and 2, transport averaged 7,200 naira a week.

card.title: A pattern-change report
card.note: Saved over four weeks. Illustrative figures.

say: Her rule: buy all ingredients in one trip each Saturday with a written list. In weeks 3 and 4, transport averaged 5,000.

card.title: A pattern-change report
card.note: Saved over four weeks. Illustrative figures.

say: She saved 2,200 naira a week, about 8,800 over four weeks, and moved it to her buffer. That is about 31 percent of her transport spending.
If your change did not work, report it honestly anyway, and say what you will try next. That shows learning.

card.title: A pattern-change report
card.note: Saved over four weeks. Illustrative figures.

say: Money habits rarely change in one person alone. But people switch off when they feel judged. Saying 'you people waste money' starts an argument.
Instead, share your own result with a real number. For example: I found I was spending about 2,000 naira a week on extra rides, and planning one trip on Saturday fixed most of it.
Choose a calm moment, not the day a bill is overdue. Start with what is going well, then show one number that needs help.

say: Ask for ideas before giving yours. Agree one action, and who will do it.

say: Agree when you will look at the number again. In a group, never ask anyone to say their income or debts aloud, and never share someone's figures without permission.

panel.rule: Never share another person's figures or debts without permission.

say: Choose your next goal from your weakest measure. Amina covers only 2 days, so her goal is 14 days covered in 90 days, which is about 13 weeks.
Her target buffer is 14 times 4,000, which is 56,000 naira. She already has 8,000, so she needs 48,000 more.
48,000 over 13 weeks is about 3,700 naira a week. It comes from 2,200 she already saves on transport, and 1,500 from cutting wants.
She sets checkpoints at week 4, week 8 and week 13. If she falls behind, she lowers the target or finds one more leak. She does not abandon the plan.

To remember. Honest records beat perfect-looking ones. Write your report with the pattern, evidence, rule and result. Hide private details. Share your own result kindly. And turn your next goal into a weekly amount with checkpoints.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Weekly amount plus checkpoints for 90 days

say: Now assemble your project folder, hold one calm money conversation, write your 90-day plan with three checkpoints, and complete the final quiz.
